title: wire tie bows
text: wire tie bows. These are OK.  the gold wire wraps are really short- barely enough to hold the bow - so if you want to attach to tree limbs - its a real challenge - nearly impossible.  The material is really wonky outdoor stuff - fake velvet stuff - the usual - very flat looking.  Some of the bows were pretty crushed and they don't really straighten out.  I am going to keep looking for some more sparkle and definitely longer wire ties.
